x.intro: Quthing is the southernmost district of Lesotho. The biggest town in the district is called Moyeni. It is by far the most diverse district in Lesotho as Baphuthi, Zulus and Xhosas are found in large numbers and still speak their native languages as opposed to other districts where indigenous cultures have vanished.

x.intro: Teyateyaneng (or TY as it is affectionately known to the locals) is a town near Lesotho's north-western border. It is a craft centre, and has a good market for locally produced goods and crafts.
Thaba-Tseka is a city of about 15,000 people (2016) in Lesotho.

intro: Lesotho is a small landlocked country entirely surrounded by South Africa. It is known as the "Kingdom in the Sky" because the entire country is at a high altitude. Its lowest point is 1,388 above sea level; no other country in the world has its lowest point above 1,000. Lesotho is a fantastic adventure holiday destination because of its smiling and resourceful people and bracing climate.

other.d: (Afri-Ski) — ski and mountain resort for skiing in winter (June - September) and mountain adventure sport in summer (October - April). One of the few places in Africa to go skiing.

x.intro: Katse is a tiny village in the Lesotho Highlands. It is near and gives its name to the Katse Dam, a huge manmade reservoir built to sell water to neighbouring South Africa.

x.around: Morija is small enough for it to be easy to get anywhere on foot or on a bicycle.
x.intro: Morija is a tiny town in north western Lesotho, about 40 miles south of Maseru. Tim Couzens' novel Murder at Morija tells of the 1920 poisoning of one of Lesotho's first missionaries. It's well worth a read before you visit! It is highly unlikely that you will be poisoned on your visit.

other.d: Maletsunyane Falls, one of the highest single drop waterfalls in the world

x.around: Semonkong is small enough for it to be possible to get around by foot.
x.intro: Semonkong is a small town in central Lesotho. In Sesotho, Semonkong literally means Place of Smoke, which is a reference to the huge 200m Maletsunyane Falls which is close to the town.
